info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contribution Analysis API
info.description: The Contribution Analysis API provides insights into the performance and profitability of various business segments within the banking sector. By leveraging data associated with specific parameters, users can analyze contributions to overall business results. This API is essential for financial analysts and business managers aiming to make data-driven decisions. Typical use cases include evaluating product performance, assessing market segments, and conducting competitive analysis.

get.summary: Retrieve contribution analysis for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed contribution analysis data for the specified resource identifier (RES-100045). The analysis may include various metrics and insights related to the contributions associated with this resource, aiding in business decision-making processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a contribution analysis for the specified resource (RES-100045). The analysis aims to provide insights into the performance metrics and related contributions. Ensure that the information provided adheres to the required schema to receive a relevant response.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the contribution analysis data.
